title: About me
text:
I am Antoine Bodein, a highly motivated Ph.D. in Molecular Medicine with a passion for unraveling complex biological questions through computational approaches. With extensive experience at the interface of computational biology and bioinformatics, my expertise spans multi-omics data integration, advanced statistical modeling, and machine learning.
I am proficient in R and Python, and I enjoy developing innovative data analysis methods to transform complex datasets into meaningful biological insights. Driven by curiosity and a collaborative spirit, I am dedicated to contributing to scientific advancement and pushing the boundaries of our understanding in life sciences. This space serves as a platform to share my work, thoughts, and projects in computational biology.

title: Antoine Bodein, Ph.D.
text:
A word about me
Highly motivated Ph.D. in Molecular Medicine with 3+ years of experience at the interface of computational biology and bioinformatics.
My expertise encompasses multi-omics data integration , statistical modeling , and machine learning , with in-depth knowledge of R and Python .
I have a proven track record in developing advanced data analysis methods and fostering research projects, and I am driven by innovation and collaborative research to address complex biological questions.

Current Position
Associate Researcher in Pr. Droit Laboratory  Université Laval, Québec, Canada 2021 — Present

Led the development and implementation of advanced bioinformatics and biostatistics approaches for multi-omics data (transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, metagenomics) integration and analysis, driving diverse research objectives.
Performed statistical data analysis to generate new research insights and hypotheses for collaborators.
Contributed to scientific advancement through literature reviews, integration of technological and methodological advances, and authorship of publications and detailed reports. -Provided training and supervision to students, fostering a collaborative research environment.
Presented research findings at scientific conferences (oral and poster presentations).
